title.zh: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备
title.en: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备

current_state.zh: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, with sources suggesting strikes could occur before the US midterm elections, targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities.
current_state.en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, with sources suggesting strikes could occur before the US midterm elections, targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities.
